title: Ravi — phone shop, Pune
note: I run a small phone repair shop on FC Road, Pune. On 15 Oct a customer paid me Rs 2,000 by UPI for a screen repair. The next morning my whole account was frozen by a cyber police station in Patna, and my balance of Rs 1,80,000 is stuck. I have the bank message, my statement, the repair bill and the chat with the customer.
